title: Conditional expectation work polynomial
statement: For a finite label set $D$ and a constraint template whose maximum predicate arity is $r$, the conditional expectation work polynomial is $|D|\bigl(|D|^r+1\bigr)X^2$, regarded as a polynomial with natural-number coefficients.
